clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: Synthetic prime lending policy for new private passenger vehicles in India, denominated in INR. For capstone demonstration only.

clauses.title: Credit score
clauses.text: A CIBIL credit score of at least 700 is required. Other bureaus are not accepted.

clauses.title: Income
clauses.text: Qualifying monthly income must be at least INR 40,000.

clauses.title: Employment
clauses.text: Salaried applicants need 12 months of continuous employment; self-employed applicants need 36 months in business. Other categories are ineligible.

clauses.title: Active loans
clauses.text: No more than 2 active loans are permitted at the time of application.

clauses.title: Debt-service limit
clauses.text: All monthly debt obligations including the new EMI must not exceed 40% of qualifying monthly income.

clauses.title: Rates
clauses.text: Fixed nominal annual rate compounded monthly: score 750 to 900 at 9.25%; score 700 to 749 at 10.5%.

clauses.title: Tenure
clauses.text: Tenure must be between 12 and 60 months.

clauses.title: Loan amount
clauses.text: Principal must be between INR 2,00,000 and INR 30,00,000.

clauses.title: Loan-to-value
clauses.text: Maximum loan-to-value is 80% of the on-road price.

clauses.title: Credit risk
clauses.text: Applications meeting parts B and C are approved only if the validated credit-risk model (vla-eligibility) estimates an approval probability of at least 0.88.

clauses.title: Fees
clauses.text: Processing fee is 1.5% of principal, minimum INR 5,000, maximum INR 25,000, payable upfront.

clauses.title: Vehicles
clauses.text: Commercial vehicles are excluded. Prices older than 90 days must be re-verified.

clauses.title: Rounding
clauses.text: EMI rounded half-up to 0.01; principal rounded down to INR 1,000.

clauses.title: Exceptions
clauses.text: Exceptions to parts B and C are not permitted for the prime product. Declined applicants may be offered the standard product of another lender.

clauses.title: Documentation
clauses.text: Identity and address proof, six months of bank statements, salary slips or two years of tax returns, and the dealer proforma invoice.
